clean_body: Let’s clear the air.| | | | | Patriot , I flew above battlefields, passing burning husks of armored vehicles, and in Iraq I poured enough sand out of my boots to fill a desert. You would think that after flying an Apache helicopter through an active war zone, and having God knows how many stray bullets shot my direction, there’s not a thing on this planet that could scare me. I thought so too, until my team reminded me about what’s coming in the next few days. Let me explain. This campaign’s bigger than anything I’ve done in Iraq. Rather than covering for a team on the ground, the fate of more than 10 million people will be decided in November. Campaigning isn’t easy, and sometimes it feels like the weight of the world is on my shoulders. Just before I typed this email, my team reminded me about our upcoming End-of-Quarter fundraising deadline. This isn’t just an arbitrary deadline; this is one of our last BIG goals before the November election. I’m not going to ask you to dig deep into your pockets. All I’m asking is a $1 or more donation, which will go right into my campaign's war chest and help me and President Trump take down the Democrat machine come November. As a combat veteran and a patriot - I give you my word that every dollar matters, and I’m eternally thankful for ANY gift you can make. Time is running out. Thank you for listening, and I hope I can count on your help. | | — John James Republican Nominee for Governor | | Paid for by John James for MI | | 35744 Van Dyke Avenue, Sterling Heights, MI 48312 The use of John James' military images, uniforms, or personnel does not imply endorsement by the Department of War or any branch of the U.S. military. |

name: OnePA Team
subject: Working people protect our democracy
body:
When working people organize, powerful people cannot simply make the rules for everyone else. | |
---
Peter, **Working people have never been handed power. We have had to organize for it, fight for it, and use it together. Election Day is one of the clearest places that power shows up.** When working people can vote without risking a paycheck, when Black communities can build political power, and when our members move together, politicians and corporations cannot simply make decisions over our heads. They have to answer to us. **A conflicting work or school schedule was the leading reason people stayed home in the 2022 midterms. Too many hourly workers are still being told to choose between a paycheck and a ballot because the company that writes the schedule decided Election Day was someone else's problem.** The 12 biggest private employers, including Walmart, Amazon, Home Depot, Target, Starbucks, Albertsons, and Kroger employ millions of people who keep this country running. There is no federal requirement that those companies give workers time off to vote. Twenty-eight states and D.C. require time off. Twenty-one of those states plus D.C. require that time to be paid. Everywhere else, the employer writes the rule. **People who want unchecked power depend on working people believing we are powerless. They benefit when voters lose faith, when communities are divided, and when the people stocking shelves and packing boxes are kept too busy to make their voices count. **The fight for economic justice and the fight for democracy have always been connected because both come down to power.**
When working people are organized and can build political power, corporations are forced to answer to the people who create their profits. That is why people who want unchecked power work so hard to silence voters, divide our communities, and keep workers on a schedule that leaves no room for democracy.
A democracy where people have a vote but no real power in their workplaces, neighborhoods, or government will always leave too much control in the hands of those with the most money and access -- including the 12 largest private employers in the U.S.: Walmart, Amazon, FedEx, Home Depot, UPS, Concentrix, Target, Marriott, Kroger, UnitedHealth Group, Berkshire Hathaway, and Starbucks. Paid time off to vote will not fix that by itself. It is one way these companies can stop standing in the way of the people they employ.

clean_body: When working people organize, powerful people cannot simply make the rules for everyone else. | | Peter, Working people have never been handed power. We have had to organize for it, fight for it, and use it together. Election Day is one of the clearest places that power shows up. They have to answer to us. A conflicting work or school schedule was the leading reason people stayed home in the 2022 midterms. Too many hourly workers are still being told to choose between a paycheck and a ballot because the company that writes the schedule decided Election Day was someone else's problem. The 12 biggest private employers, including Walmart, Amazon, Home Depot, Target, Starbucks, Albertsons, and Kroger employ millions of people who keep this country running. Everywhere else, the employer writes the rule. People who want unchecked power depend on working people believing we are powerless. They benefit when voters lose faith, when communities are divided, and when the people stocking shelves and packing boxes are kept too busy to make their voices count. body:
He says one thing... but the record shows something else. | | | | [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/ksmUNF8Z0TQ?e=6679001ba0&c2id=4b8979688b40abb82eda840804c92b8e)

| | | Friend,

Bill Hill is running as an "independent." His own record tells a different story.

**Federal campaign finance records show Hill personally donated to socialists Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez, Bernie Sanders, and Kamala Harris.** When Alaskans put their own money behind AOC and Bernie Sanders, that tells you exactly where their politics are, no matter what label they put on the ballot.

And it's not just who Hill supports. It's who's supporting him.
**A Washington, DC-based super PAC has poured more than $2 million into propping up Hill's campaign — more than Hill has raised himself.**

The mailers in your mailbox, the TV ads, the texts on your phone? Paid for by outside, Lower 48 money. And the trail behind that PAC runs through a web of nonprofit organizations that never have to disclose their donors. Alaskans may never know who's really writing the checks to buy this seat.

**He won't even tell voters who he'd caucus with in Congress.**

See the records for yourself — FEC filings, news reports, the full money trail at **[www.TheRealBillHill.com](https://us.list-manage.com/1Cpa1ycktZS?e=6679001ba0&c2id=4b8979688b40abb82eda840804c92b8e)**.

Alaska's seat in Congress should be decided by Alaskans, not by anonymous donors in Washington and California. Share **[TheRealBillHill.com](https://us.list-manage.com/NnIF7EWfPX5?e=6679001ba0&c2id=4b8979688b40abb82eda840804c92b8e)** with your friends, family, and neighbors before you fill out your ballot.

For Alaska,
Team Begich

Peter, we sat
down with a room full of Michiganders to show them our ads and get their
honest thoughts. The one they couldn't stop talking about was "Mr. Larry."
👇

[ Abdul ]Abdul and Mr Larry

If you haven’t seen it, it’s about a man named Mr. Larry, who, after an
accident, ended up with tons of medical debt. One day, he opened a letter
in the mail and found out that debt was gone — all thanks to a program
Abdul spearheaded that’s set to cancel $700 million in medical debt for

name: Voto Latino
subject: Have you seen what’s happening in Arizona?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Help us fight back in Arizona →
#
Peter, this is urgent:
A federal appeals court just reinstated **two dangerous voter suppression laws** in Arizona, making it harder for young people and Latino voters to make their voices heard this election.
[](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260912-1.obvBK1&amount=3&refcode=em20260912-579&t=1&akid=579%2E1366028%2ES4IMnq)
Now, with just _weeks_ until this consequential midterm election, **voters face the risk of having their registration canceled just for crossing county lines** — and **new penalties threaten community members** who help relatives or neighbors navigate the voting process.
Peter, Republicans are pulling out all of the stops to rig our elections — but **Voto Latino is fighting back. We’re on the ground in the community and on campuses, ensuring Arizona voters are informed and can make their voices heard at the ballot box.**
**[As a grassroots-powered organization, we need your help to supercharge our voter protection efforts. Can you make a donation of $3 immediately to claim a stake in this fight?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260912-1.obvBK1&amount=3&refcode=em20260912-579&t=2&akid=579%2E1366028%2ES4IMnq)**
We know exactly why these laws were passed — to shrink the electorate and suppress turnout in a crucial swing state.
That’s why we’re fighting back by registering every eligible Latino voter we can reach in Arizona and across the country and making sure voters are aware of these anti-voter restrictions.
**With Arizona’s voter registration deadline quickly approaching on October 5th and early voting starting on October 7th** , we’re doubling down on our organizing efforts to ensure every voter in our community is registered, up to date, and ready to vote.
**[Will you chip in $3 to power Voto Latino’s voter registration drives and defeat voter suppression on the ground?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20260912-1.obvBK1&amount=3&refcode=em20260912-579&t=3&akid=579%2E1366028%2ES4IMnq)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

body:
| Peter,

I hope you’re well! I’m reaching out because I know how much you care about helping Democrats take back the House Majority.

The stakes are high, but the math is simple.
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=41572%2E3422442%2EWwJ82F)
Peter,
There are only 52 days until the midterm elections, and if we’re going to put a stop to Trump’s agenda, we have serious work to do.
Let me pull out my whiteboard to break down what we’re facing:
[](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260912_1_ak.gp_Zjr&refcode=em20260912-41572&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=41572%2E3422442%2EWwJ82F)
The stakes are high, but the math is simple: over the next 52 days, we have to do everything possible to make sure Democrats win in the most important races in the country.
Truth to Power is supporting a slate of battleground candidates. We’re making sure leaders who will stand up for working families have the resources they need to win—no matter how much corporate PACs spend against them.
I need you with me if we’re going to take back the House and Senate in November. Time’s running out, and our movement relies entirely on grassroots support from people like you.
**[Peter, can you pitch in $5—or whatever you can afford today—to help us take back Congress?](https://act.katieporter.com/go/21531?c0=em_ms_ttp_20260912_1_ak.gp_Zjr&refcode=em20260912-41572&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=41572%2E3422442%2EWwJ82F)**

Thank you for standing with us,
Katie Porter

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: This is a global movement, and we are not alone
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
I traveled to Uruguay, Spain, Germany, and Ireland to build our global progressive movement. Here’s what I learned:
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260912-6712-footer&t=1&akid=6712%2E420207%2EWr7JzW)
Peter,
To fight authoritarianism at home, we have to fight it across the globe — because its reach doesn’t stop at our borders.
_And neither can our resistance._
I spent the last two weeks of August traveling to different countries — learning, connecting, and building our international progressive network with extraordinary leaders across the world.
What I found was a simple, but powerful truth: **this is a global movement. And we are not alone.**
**Our first stop was in Montevideo, Uruguay.** I led the U.S. delegation to the PanAmerican Congress — a gathering of progressive legislators from 17 countries across the Western Hemisphere focused on shared prosperity, security, and peace. I spoke at the opening ceremony about our movement’s opposition and resistance to the Trump administration’s military aggression.
**What struck me most was how universal our fight feels right now — because it is.**
Leaders from across Latin America are grappling with the same forces we are. The rise of authoritarianism, the erosion of democratic normalcy, and the need to build sustained people-powered movements that have the ability to endure beyond the current moment.
**Then as I was making my way across Europe, I noticed a pattern in every country I visited: Healthcare, paid leave, childcare.**
European countries have built social safety nets that give working families more control over their lives. Our country hasn't. And I believe that absence, that feeling of instability, is exactly what makes it easier for politicians to point the finger at our most vulnerable people instead of addressing the real failures of our system.
**I traveled to Madrid, where Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez’s government is one of the most encouraging examples of progressive governance in Europe right now.**
I met with ministers on transportation, civil service, and leaders in migration policy — and what I heard was devastating. Trump’s cruel anti-immigrant agenda is already rippling outward, emboldening right-wing forces across the continent and making the work of humane migration policy harder everywhere.
I sat down with the chair of Left Bloc, who told me all about their citizens’ initiative to stop funding Israel’s genocide in Gaza. It had over a _million_ signatures. That’s what people power looks like.
**From Madrid, I traveled to Berlin — and the conversations there were some of the most clarifying of the trip.**
I met with leaders from every major party in Germany, and what I heard was a mix of fear and determination. The far right is rising there, and they’re watching what’s happening in America very closely. But here’s the thing — so is the left. There was a real hunger to understand how we’re organizing, how we’re getting our message out, and how we stand up for working people every single day.
**In Ireland, I had a conversation at Trinity College Dublin with national treasure and journalist Fintan O'Toole. It was honest, and deeply grounding.** He reminded me that democracies have come back from darker moments than this one — staying in the fight is itself a form of hope.
And the moment that will truly stay with me for a lifetime happened in Northern Ireland. **I attended a retreat bringing together 30 Palestinian and Israeli young women leaders, all actively engaged in peacebuilding in their region. To sit in that room and witness that kind of courage and compassion was a reminder that we must never surrender to hopelessness or powerlessness.**
I was moved when I learned that some of the organizers there had drawn direct inspiration from our Resistance Lab in building their own organizing model.
**That is our movement bearing fruit, Peter. The work we’re doing together is reaching further than we could ever imagine.**
I came home with a full heart and an even deeper commitment to this work. It has never been clearer: the rise of fascism and authoritarianism is a global fight. _And so is the resistance._
I’m more committed than ever to building our global network of progressives. People who are organized, connected, and fighting together to put power back into the hands of everyday people everywhere.
[**If you’re able, please pitch in $3 today or whatever you can to help me keep building that movement — here at home and around the world?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260912.wDIyMd&refcode=em20260912-6712&amount=3&t=2&akid=6712%2E420207%2EWr7JzW)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-em-20260912.wDIyMd&amount=3&refcode=em20260912-6712&t=21&akid=6712%2E420207%2EWr7JzW)**
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

name: Roy Cooper
subject: What your $5 can do today
body:
MAGA Inc. is spending to defeat me. I need your help ASAP.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1319&source=&t=1&akid=3419%2E124072%2Ea6GnQu) | | | |
---
Peter, I needed to reach out with a critical update:
**With experts saying the path to Senate control runs through North Carolina, President Trump’s personal super PAC has officially gotten involved in this race – all to defeat me and prop up my GOP opponent, Michael Whatley.**
That’s why I’m asking you to make your first donation to my campaign – right here, right now. [**_If that’s all you need to hear, you can click this ActBlue link to send me $5 or whatever you can spare._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1319&amount=5&t=8&akid=3419%2E124072%2Ea6GnQu)
Otherwise, let me explain why your support is so important today.
By giving $5, you’ll join the hundreds of thousands of people who have pitched in to claim a stake in our grassroots movement.
By giving $5, you’ll be saying that you refuse to let the GOP dark-money machine buy this seat for President Trump’s handpicked candidate, former Big Oil lobbyist and ultimate DC insider Michael Whatley.
By giving $5, you’ll help us reach our $25,000 daily fundraising goal for emails like this.
**This number isn’t arbitrary, Peter – it’s what my team has calculated we need to raise before midnight to keep pace with the GOP’s spending. If we fall short, we could be putting our chances of flipping this seat on Nov. 3 in real jeopardy.**
I know that not everyone can donate to every message we send, but given the stakes of this race – and the recent news of President Trump’s spending here – I’m hoping you’ll chip in to this one.
[**_Will you chip in your first contribution of $5 to help us meet our critical fundraising target, win in North Carolina and take back the Senate for Democrats?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1319&amount=5&t=9&akid=3419%2E124072%2Ea6GnQu)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/16105?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1319&amount=5&t=10&akid=3419%2E124072%2Ea6GnQu)

Roy Cooper

Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1319&source=&t=3&akid=3419%2E124072%2Ea6GnQu)

_Nadia was only 15 years old when they went looking for her. _ A pastor had called House Parent Project, a children's home in Mexico. He knew Nadia was in danger. He even knew the Metro station in Mexico City where she could often be found.So the house parents went and they found her. But to understand what happened next, you need to know where Nadia came from. She never knew her father. Her mother lived an unstable and dangerous life, moving from one man to another. Nadia was the oldest of three little girls. Her youngest sister was given up for adoption. But Nadia grew up with almost nothing and no one. She survived on the streets of Mexico City, surrounded by drugs, prostitution, abandonment, and exploitation. Imagine being 15 years old and wondering if there is a single adult in this world you can trust. That was the girl they found near that Metro station. There was doubt in Nadia's eyes. But they asked her to give them a chance.

She left behind a horrible life and came home to parents who would raise her as their own. Peter, Nadia's story is one reason **Sound of Freedom Foundation** works with groups like House Parent Project.My name is Eduardo Verastegui. They rescued her too. Today, Sofia works full time caring for other children who have experienced the same kinds of brokenness. Then something beautiful happened in Nadia's life. She met Joseph, who had also grown up in the same Village - the House Parent Project community. They fell in love. They married, Joseph became a foreman, and the couple moved away for several years. They welcomed a son and daughter of their own. Yet they kept coming back for Christmas, Mother's Day, and birthdays. **Their hearts were still with the children. **Finally, in 2019, Nadia and Joseph came home permanently. Today, **they are second in command at one of the large children 's homes**. The child who once needed someone to find her**grew up to help care for children who need to be found. **That is**restoration**. That is **hope**. And that is why I am writing to you. name: Deb Haaland
subject: Donald Trump’s New America
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY DEB FOR NEW MEXICO**
body:
I’m running for New Mexico.

| | |
---
Friend, in case you missed it: **Donald Trump wants to change the name of New Mexico to New America.**
[](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1372-fr-nd&t=1&akid=12392%2E400544%2ENvtm5q)
Instead of focusing on the issues that matter to hardworking families, he’s pushing another distraction while families face higher costs and rising gas prices.
Here’s my message: **New Mexico will always be New Mexico.**
If my Republican opponent wants to welcome Donald Trump’s extremist agenda into our state, then he can be the Governor of New America. **Meanwhile, I’m fighting for New Mexicans and standing up for what makes New Mexico, New Mexico.[That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help elect me and make sure New Mexico always has a fighter in its corner?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1372-fr-nd&t=2&akid=12392%2E400544%2ENvtm5q)**
| | [Donate Now >>>](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1372-fr-nd&t=3&akid=12392%2E400544%2ENvtm5q)
---
Being New Mexican is something special.
Our roots run deep. They’re in the acequias, cornfields, lowriders, and chile harvests. In the food we cook and the traditions we pass down, and in the communities that have cared for one another for generations.
My roots here run 35 generations deep. I am the proud descendant of fierce Pueblo women, a grandfather who worked as a diesel mechanic and tended his cornfield, a grandmother who taught me to love New Mexican cooking, and parents who taught me the meaning of service and sacrifice.
These aren’t just my stories. **_They’re part of what makes New Mexico, New Mexico._**
So when Donald Trump talks about taking away the name and identity that generations of New Mexicans have built, I can’t just stand by. And when my opponent wants to bring Donald Trump’s extremist agenda to New Mexico and cut Medicaid, SNAP, and Universal Childcare, I have to fight back.
I have a vision for New Mexico that starts with our people: **higher wages, lower costs, stronger schools, and healthcare that’s there when you need it.** I want to invest in mental and behavioral healthcare, substance use treatment, rehabilitation, and housing stability so we can build safer, stronger communities.
**_But I can’t do it alone._[That’s why I need your help right now. Will you chip in $5 or whatever you can spare to help me win this race, so I can keep fighting for New Mexico?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/16523?refcode=jtk1372-fr-nd&t=4&akid=12392%2E400544%2ENvtm5q)**
Be Fierce,

Deb

body:
Online safety is a major threat in today’s world.

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139083246/646165675/1389201924?refcode=AU_NWB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20260912_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDY5NjYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWY4ODYzZWItZTFhZS1mMTExLTliMzMtMDAyMjQ4MmE5ZjFkIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=zq_Ew7SXkTW-BiIaaR5YVrBjSu5M3guMGp66U-Fk9UQ=&emci=b17ede3a-03ae-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&emdi=1f8863eb-e1ae-f111-9b33-0022482a9f1d&ceid=35688492)
---
Hi Peter — My office just released the first-ever Washington State Attorney General’s Data Privacy Report, and the findings make one thing clear: Washingtonians deserve more control over their personal information. **83%** of Washingtonians said they had little or no control over who could access their personal information. And **95%** said they would not be comfortable having their information collected, shared, or sold without informed consent. **In 2025, my office received reports of 209 data breaches affecting more than 8 million Washington residents. body:
With this shift in strategy, the court is handing the most criminal and treasonous president in American history near unlimited power.
| | | | Defend Our Courts is leading the fight to build a firewall of state supreme courts and independent judges to stop MAGA. Thank you for your crucial support. However [if you'd like to unsubscribe](https://audience.constantcontact.com/preferences/unsubscribe?m=001FsF7-CVwOWlW43i5_6VYsQ==&c=e45c6208-5e86-11f0-b060-fa163e5551a4&ca=11e4025c-3b26-4ec8-a5cf-53a262a55cba), you can do so at the link at the bottom of this email.

|
Peter,
What do you do when you're the highest court in the land, capable of calling balls and strikes on the Constitution, and the man who appointed you keeps flagrantly violating it?
You just rule that no one can sue him, apparently.
That's the trick Erwin Chemerinsky, dean of the UC Berkeley School of Law, is sounding the alarm about. In an interview on Slate's Amicus podcast, he described how the court has recently shifted strategy, refusing to rule on the legality of Trump's actions and instead tossing the lawsuits out altogether on technicalities:
---
| | [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gqy73n2WZAqoFbHpConXwezNio0EyP1nMBC0iR0zdENYyrcWXQLDjeWEa7u4gWXpLG4Icc7c48xv2k7usGDGyeKs7su8eeIR280qIcXBiu3dQmBc4BheePW0Ht3meS2R88giTkWgLrwOnxJSbMSi4WCiNJEF-teUEIewGhTRrhCYqmPwxO4akSqk1Kr9P8JX4l2_BJQDJdbRAf67UMfDUEmMECReJ8zIR5t3bILmtVo=&c=6r5Ll_k8CyobSbNur7bbrcTVohJvo1FO4Tn0D_s3SMRQKQSWY0Cf5Q==&ch=huGWP9K7A1gm4PupvPvtl9hnmPnpvX0VE163za1X-KKmLfgXeL8Vlw==)
---
Unconstitutional mail-in voting restrictions? The plaintiffs sued too soon.
Trump's illegal ballroom construction? The plaintiffs have no standing.
Incite a violent insurrection? The president has complete criminal immunity.
The court is handing the most criminal and treasonous president in American history near unlimited power. SCOTUS is inching closer and closer each day to effectively appointing Trump a dictator, and it's bringing our Democracy to the brink.
When Democrats regain control of the House, Senate, and Presidency, we will have little choice. To save our democracy, we will need to expand the number of Justices on the Court and restore a balanced, nonpartisan, pro-democracy Court.
It's not a radical idea. The number of justices on the Court has changed seven times before. Congress has the authority to do it again, no constitutional amendment needed, just a bill passed by the House and Senate and signed into law by the president.
More and more Democratic leaders have endorsed expanding the Court, from Kamala Harris to AOC to Rep. Jim Clyburn just weeks ago:
---
| [](https://yfq78zhbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Gqy73n2WZAqoFbHpConXwezNio0EyP1nMBC0iR0zdENYyrcWXQLDjeWEa7u4gWXpLG4Icc7c48xv2k7usGDGyeKs7su8eeIR280qIcXBiu3dQmBc4BheePW0Ht3meS2R88giTkWgLrwOnxJSbMSi4WCiNJEF-teUEIewGhTRrhCYqmPwxO4akSqk1Kr9P8JX4l2_BJQDJdbRAf67UMfDUEmMECReJ8zIDX5yCw3Z1sM=&c=6r5Ll_k8CyobSbNur7bbrcTVohJvo1FO4Tn0D_s3SMRQKQSWY0Cf5Q==&ch=huGWP9K7A1gm4PupvPvtl9hnmPnpvX0VE163za1X-KKmLfgXeL8Vlw==)
---
Earlier this Summer, Defend Our Courts launched our Unpack Our Courts initiative, the campaign to reform and rebalance the Supreme Court. We are building the political momentum for SCOTUS reform so that when Democrats retake power, we can move swiftly to save our Democracy.
But first, we have to win big this November. Democrats need to run the numbers up so high that Trump's election rigging attempts crumble, and win as many seats as possible to build the majorities we need in Congress, so we're ready to get things done the moment we win back the White House in 2028.
That's why we're laser-focused on these midterms, and why we need your help now more than ever as we enter the final two months of this election. To compete on a national scale, in critical state Supreme Court races and House and Senate races alike, we need a war chest big enough to make a major impact.

When Democrats regain control of the House, Senate, and Presidency, we will have little choice. The number of justices on the Court has changed seven times before. Congress has the authority to do it again, no constitutional amendment needed, just a bill passed by the House and Senate and signed into law by the president. Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to take back control of Congress this November. # We're in This Together
---
| | | _Friends and Supporters,_ I am so honored and energized to be on the ballot in November following our victory in the primary on August 11th! On primary election night we watched the election results surrounded by volunteers and friends. As the numbers trickled in from communities across the 7th congressional district I thought about the faces and people in those communities who I have gotten to know over the course of this campaign. I thought of their stories, their small businesses, their families, their struggles, and what they told me they need most from their representative in Congress. And at the end of election night I was truly moved that my connection with so many hardworking people in northern Wisconsin had earned me their votes. Our whole team and I are endlessly grateful. Our incredible and growing team of volunteers and I jumped right into action as the general election campaign got underway. Clark for Wisconsin team members have hit a lot of county fairs, we have kept the sunscreen industry in business marching in parades down small town main streets. I have held town halls and met people for coffee and visited businesses and farms. Volunteers have made handmade Clark for Congress signs that are popping up all across the district as I drive from Cornucopia to Marshfield, and New Richmond to Florence. Like these signs, our campaign continues to be built by hand and powered by people! With new volunteers joining everyday it is exciting to feel the momentum of this moment as we all work toward a victory in November. Many of you know that I’m a sailor. On primary election night after the results were in I compared the moment to sailing from the safe harbor of the Apostle Islands out into the open water of Lake Superior. We are ready for the challenges ahead, we have a sound vessel, we have a good wind, and we have an outstanding crew. We need all hands on deck in our people-powered campaign for Congress. I hope you join us!
---
---
---
| | | Fred
---
| | | |
---
# **On the Road**
---
| | |
---
| | | _Labor Day_ Fred and Team Clark attended Labor Day parades in Merrill and Wausau on Monday. Thank you to the North Central WI Central Labor Council for organizing this. It was clear from both of these communities that supporting fair wages and fair treatment for workers all over Wisconsin is a top priority.Fred also met with candidates for office and labor leaders from the Wausau Labor Temple. There he got to learn more about the ongoing work Wausau labor leaders are doing. Working people are an essential part of making life in our communities safe and secure, which is why showing up for labor matters.Fred’s favorite part of the campaign is getting to hear directly from community members about the issues that matter most to them.
---
| | | _Pig Roast and Trap Shoot_ This past Sunday, Fred joined the Cable Rod and Gun Club at their annual Pig Roast and Trap Shoot. He talked with members about the Apostle Islands, hunter safety training programs, and more. Fred grabbed a burger with residents and visitors at the Elkhorn Lodge in Clam Lake. He met with Doug Thorp, the Chair of the Town of Gordon (southern Ashland County). Doug explained the crisis rural communities are facing with budget cuts and a decline in volunteers for EMS services. In order to make sure our communities have the critical infrastructure they need, something has to change. Conversations like these are important because when you show up, you learn more about the people you’ll be working for.
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| | _94th Annual Rutabaga Festival in Cumberland_ Fred joined thousands of residents at the 94th Annual Rutabaga Festival in Cumberland. The community is fired up and ready to enact change, and Fred is right there with them.
---
| | | _Manoomin Week at the Bad River Tribe Powwow grounds_ Earlier this month, Fred was invited by the Bad River Tribal leaders to attend the kick off for Manoomin (wild rice) Week in Wisconsin at the Bad River Tribe’s Powwow grounds at Old Odanah. The Bad River Natural Resources staff took participants on boat tours through Kakagon Sloughs, thousands of acres of an extensive wetland with wild rice beds.

clean_body: We are ready for the challenges ahead| | | | We're in This Together | | | Friends and Supporters, I am so honored and energized to be on the ballot in November following our victory in the primary on August 11th! On primary election night we watched the election results surrounded by volunteers and friends. As the numbers trickled in from communities across the 7th congressional district I thought about the faces and people in those communities who I have gotten to know over the course of this campaign. I thought of their stories, their small businesses, their families, their struggles, and what they told me they need most from their representative in Congress. And at the end of election night I was truly moved that my connection with so many hardworking people in northern Wisconsin had earned me their votes. Our whole team and I are endlessly grateful. Our incredible and growing team of volunteers and I jumped right into action as the general election campaign got underway. Clark for Wisconsin team members have hit a lot of county fairs, we have kept the sunscreen industry in business marching in parades down small town main streets. I have held town halls and met people for coffee and visited businesses and farms. Volunteers have made handmade Clark for Congress signs that are popping up all across the district as I drive from Cornucopia to Marshfield, and New Richmond to Florence. Like these signs, our campaign continues to be built by hand and powered by people! With new volunteers joining everyday it is exciting to feel the momentum of this moment as we all work toward a victory in November. Many of you know that I’m a sailor. On primary election night after the results were in I compared the moment to sailing from the safe harbor of the Apostle Islands out into the open water of Lake Superior. We are ready for the challenges ahead, we have a sound vessel, we have a good wind, and we have an outstanding crew. We need all hands on deck in our people-powered campaign for Congress. I hope you join us! | | | Fred | | | | On the Road | | | | | | Labor Day Fred and Team Clark attended Labor Day parades in Merrill and Wausau on Monday. Thank you to the North Central WI Central Labor Council for organizing this. It was clear from both of these communities that supporting fair wages and fair treatment for workers all over Wisconsin is a top priority.Fred also met with candidates for office and labor leaders from the Wausau Labor Temple. There he got to learn more about the ongoing work Wausau labor leaders are doing. Working people are an essential part of making life in our communities safe and secure, which is why showing up for labor matters.Fred’s favorite part of the campaign is getting to hear directly from community members about the issues that matter most to them. | | | Pig Roast and Trap Shoot This past Sunday, Fred joined the Cable Rod and Gun Club at their annual Pig Roast and Trap Shoot. He talked with members about the Apostle Islands, hunter safety training programs, and more. Fred grabbed a burger with residents and visitors at the Elkhorn Lodge in Clam Lake. He met with Doug Thorp, the Chair of the Town of Gordon (southern Ashland County). Doug explained the crisis rural communities are facing with budget cuts and a decline in volunteers for EMS services. In order to make sure our communities have the critical infrastructure they need, something has to change. Conversations like these are important because when you show up, you learn more about the people you’ll be working for. | | | | | | | | 94th Annual Rutabaga Festival in Cumberland Fred joined thousands of residents at the 94th Annual Rutabaga Festival in Cumberland. The community is fired up and ready to enact change, and Fred is right there with them. | | | Manoomin Week at the Bad River Tribe Powwow grounds Earlier this month, Fred was invited by the Bad River Tribal leaders to attend the kick off for Manoomin (wild rice) Week in Wisconsin at the Bad River Tribe’s Powwow grounds at Old Odanah. The Bad River Natural Resources staff took participants on boat tours through Kakagon Sloughs, thousands of acres of an extensive wetland with wild rice beds. | | | | | | | | | Get Your Clark for Wisconsin Merch | | | Visit our merch shop and show off your support for Fred! Use code CLARK25 for 25% off. If you are not already on our volunteer email list and you would like to get involved, sign up ! We will be knocking doors, talking to voters, and so much more! | | | Volunteer If you are not already on our volunteer email list and you would like to get involved, sign up ! We will be knocking doors, talking to voters, and so much more! | | | | Every Sunday and Wednesday, 6-7pm: Phone Banking for Fred Register for ZoomWeekly phone banking sessions on Sundays and Wednesdays. We will teach you how to do it and go over the steps. Then we will spend the rest of the time phone banking. If you already know how to phone bank, we will send you to the Zoom breakout room with others who have phone banked before. Monday, September 21, 6-8pm: Community Child Care Conversation Cable Natural History Museum, 13470 Co Hwy M, Cable, WI 54821 Hear from your fellow constituents and share your perspective on the challenges impacting families in our community. Together we can support community solutions that can create accessible and affordable options for families. Friday, September 25, evening: Rally in Hudson Keep your eye on your inbox for more details. Wednesday, September 30, 7:30-8:30am: Rhinelander Coffee Hour R&T;’s “Not So” Dinky Diner, 130 N. Wednesday, September 30, 9:30-10:30am: Merrill Coffee Hour Join us for a cup of coffee and share the issues that matter most to you.Email mailto:info@clarkforwi.com for details. Thursday, October 1, evening: Rally for the North in Rhinelander Keep an eye on our social media for more information. I’m so grateful to every Granite Stater who put their trust in me and helped build this campaign together.

Growing up in Manchester and working alongside my family at our restaurant, I learned that you don’t get ahead just by making promises. You have to be accountable. You listen to people, work hard, and deliver.

That’s the same approach I’ve brought to Congress, and it’s why I’m running for the Senate.

body:
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/139084143/646168837/-569431239?refcode=260912-invented-rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NzI2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyODZjOWQ1OC1lOGFlLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDIyNDgyYTlmMWQiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KwcO7efHkazWUc8QVVUxIV-Ms3c7QPDxEkqBpH9yjB0=)
---
| | | Oregon didn't just adopt vote-by-mail. We INVENTED it. **So when the US Supreme Court cleared the way for Trump's executive order restricting mail-in ballots, understand what that means: ** No state has more on the line than Oregon. This order isn't aimed at some abstract "voting system." **It targets how every single Oregonian votes.** Here's what Trump’s USPS order does. It orders the Postal Service to deliver ballots only to voters on a federal list — a list built by THIS administration. Their postmaster already said the quiet part out loud: states that don't hand over their voter data likely won't have mail ballots delivered at all. Now here's what I know. **I'm Oregon's chief elections officer. We have taken this administration to court twice — over their demand for your voter data, and over their first election order. We won both times.** **And now we’ve filed suit again. ** **The Constitution hasn't changed** since then. States run elections. Not presidents. Not postmasters. We won nearly 50% of the vote in our open primary election last month, against 15 other candidates of all parties – including incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan. # How Washington State Democrats Keep Winning
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/AGLsvw5ZHGp?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e)
| | In the 2024 general election, every state had major shifts towards Republicans – but not Washington. For five election cycles in a row, Washington State Democrats have increased or maintained their majorities in the state legislature, and have acheived an 8-2 Democratic majority in their U.S. House of Representatives delegation.
So how do Washington State Democrats keep winning?__ To find out, we asked one of the best organizers around - **DNC Vice Chair and Washington State Democratic Party Chair Shasti Conrad.**
Shasti has made history time and time again as the first woman of color and youngest ever Chair of Washington State Democrats as well as the first ever woman of South Asian descent to chair any state party in America. Under her leadership, Washington State Democrats has continued to grow and thrive, but she’s not done making history.
If you want to know the secrets behind Washington State Democrats’ success and how she plans to win big this November, we encourage you to read [her story](https://us.list-manage.com/x_NWbI9oSlT?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e) below.

We are **8 weeks away from Election Day** , and here at AZ Dems, we're laser-focused on electing Democrats up and down the ballot. Folks,
In a minute, I need to ask you to please **[donate $5 to help my campaign run ads that will win over undecided Nevada voters.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260912_2_ak.HBZzzu&amount=5&refcode=em20260912-866&t=3&akid=873%2E127862%2EV0oNbP)**
First, I hope you’ll let me explain why your support will make an impact in these crucial final weeks before Election Day.
The polls are showing Joe Lombardo and me locked in a dead heat. And if you’ve turned on your TV or gone on social media in these past few weeks, you already know that MAGA Republicans are blanketing Nevada with attack ads. That is why our campaign has no choice but to respond urgently by running our own ads to persuade and mobilize voters across our state _before it’s too late._
**Running ads in media markets like Las Vegas and Reno during an election year is incredibly costly** – but we must compete over the airwaves to have a shot at winning this governor’s seat and flipping Nevada blue.
**Our ability to reach undecided Nevada voters through TV, digital, and radio ads will all come down to how much we can raise to fund that mission-critical work.** Together, we can win. The polls have made that clear. We just need to finish this campaign strong. Can you help me do that with a donation today?
**[Help me get our message in front of as many Nevadans as possible before November 3rd. Please pitch in $5 or more right now.](https://act.fordfornevada.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_af_20260912_2_ak.HBZzzu&amount=5&refcode=em20260912-866&t=4&akid=873%2E127862%2EV0oNbP)**

name: Roy Cooper
subject: They’re lying about my record … again
body:
A wave of attack ads is trying to distort my record as Governor.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1320&source=&t=1&akid=3399%2E124072%2ESgoQeH) | | | |
---
Peter,
In case you haven’t seen it yet, the Senate GOP’s top super PAC is running a wave of attack ads across North Carolina to distort my record as Governor.
The story they’re telling didn’t even happen here – they’re blaming me for a crime committed in _South Carolina by a South Carolina criminal who was released from a South Carolina jail!_
But the people who are seeing the ad don’t know that, and it’s working – a recent poll out since the ad started running shows that my MAGA opponent and I are **statistically tied.**
In an ultracompetitive race like this, letting these lies go unanswered risks letting my opponent take the lead – and we can’t take back the Senate for Democrats if we lose in North Carolina.
We need to fight back immediately – but whether we have the resources to turn this around hinges on a surge of grassroots donations from supporters like you.
[**_So if you can, Peter, I need you to pitch in $5 today, or any amount you’re able, to help me ensure NC voters know the truth. Will you help me fight back and flip this seat blue?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1320&amount=5&t=8&akid=3399%2E124072%2ESgoQeH)

primary.

A simple truth about election integrity: it's not a conspiracy theory, it's list maintenance -- and blue states are failing at it.
Analysis of the 2024 voter rolls found that blue states accounted for roughly 85% of the nation's duplicate voter registrations. That's not a rounding error. New York alone had over 511,000 duplicate registrations simultaneously active, according to one recent review. New Jersey's rolls carried more than 32,000 questionable records, per the Public Interest Legal Foundation. And it's not just one study -- PILF's national report, "Critical Condition," documented dead voters, duplicates, and errors across the country.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e350e582-e4d5-4cc3-a424-fedaae075cf2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
To be fair, this isn't a red-state-vs-blue-state morality play. Red states have messes too -- Arkansas just found nearly 1,300 people registered there and in Tennessee or Alabama. What the heck North Carolina? The difference? Red states are hunting duplicates down. The states with the worst bloat keep resisting basic list maintenance, treating every cleanup request as voter suppression.
Duplicates don't guarantee fraud, but they guarantee opportunity -- and they erode the one thing elections can't function without: confidence. Cleaning the rolls shouldn't be partisan. It's housework. Do it.
Sources: Public Interest Legal Foundation; state election reports.

Blue States, Duplicate Voters, and the Housework Nobody Wants to Do | | | Sep 12 | | | | | | | | | | | | A simple truth about election integrity: it's not a conspiracy theory, it's list maintenance -- and blue states are failing at it. Analysis of the 2024 voter rolls found that blue states accounted for roughly 85% of the nation's duplicate voter registrations. That's not a rounding error. New York alone had over 511,000 duplicate registrations simultaneously active, according to one recent review. New Jersey's rolls carried more than 32,000 questionable records, per the Public Interest Legal Foundation. And it's not just one study -- PILF's national report, "Critical Condition," documented dead voters, duplicates, and errors across the country. | | ---|---|--- To be fair, this isn't a red-state-vs-blue-state morality play. Red states have messes too -- Arkansas just found nearly 1,300 people registered there and in Tennessee or Alabama. What the heck North Carolina? The difference? Red states are hunting duplicates down. The states with the worst bloat keep resisting basic list maintenance, treating every cleanup request as voter suppression. Duplicates don't guarantee fraud, but they guarantee opportunity -- and they erode the one thing elections can't function without: confidence. Cleaning the rolls shouldn't be partisan. It's housework. Do it. Sources: Public Interest Legal Foundation; state election reports. You're currently a free subscriber to . This message isn’t for everyone,
Peter.

We’re reaching out directly to you because you haven’t chipped in to the
Squad Victory Fund yet, and right now we need you more than
ever.

We have less than eight weeks until the midterms, and all four of our
Squad members — Alexandria, Ayanna, Ilhan, and Rashida — are up for
reelection. They’re fighting for working people, not corporate PACs, not
special interests, and not the highest bidder.

That means they’re counting on this grassroots team to have their backs.

Every single day, the MAGA machine is coming for our freedoms — bodily
autonomy, voting rights, the right to organize, democracy itself. They’re
outspending us, overwhelming voters, and hoping everyday people like you
get tired of the noise. But it won’t work on a movement like
ours, Peter.

This is what people power actually looks like: showing up again, and
again, and again, because we don't quit and we don't fight alone. The
Squad is our firewall in Congress — for working families, for racial
justice, for the climate, for every fight that others won't touch.

Hey folks,
Trump is getting desperate about the midterms--and we need to take what he's saying seriously.
Between his bizarre January 6th posts, warnings from a conservative former federal judge, and Republicans already attacking voting access, this one gets dark fast. But the answer isn't panic. It's making the wave so big they can't deny it.
* [**00:01:50**] Trump suddenly reposts his January 6th message to Capitol rioters--and I explain why the timing feels like a signal.
* [**00:04:46**] A Bush-appointed former federal judge sounds the alarm about the possibility of another January 6th after the midterms.
* [**00:07:12**] Here's the mission: create the biggest, most undeniable Democratic wave possible in November.
* [**00:09:56**] We dig into the generic ballot numbers and why the political environment could put places Democrats normally don't win into play.
* [**00:12:06**] The bottom line: stay calm, stay alert, and be ready to act. We cannot afford to sit this election out.

This episode is about what Trump and his allies could try if voters reject them--and what all of us can do now to make that rejection impossible to ignore. We talk January 6th, threats to the democratic process, voting access, the polling, and why organizing everyone around us matters. name: Chris Deluzio
subject: Remember this?
body:
[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/46?t=1001&akid=74%2E42639%2EOoRHg- ]Chris Deluzio for PA

Remember this?

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/28?c0=deluzio-em-26-q3.tyfWFC&refcode=em260912&t=1002&akid=74%2E42639%2EOoRHg- ]'Aerial image of the railway disaster in East Palestine'

That is a photo from the 2023 East Palestine Norfolk Southern derailment
that sent that toxic fireball into the sky.

In the immediate aftermath, residents reported a number of well-document
short term symptoms from the chemicals released into the air. Long-term,
the National Institutes of Health and several universities are studying
the long-term impact of the disaster.

In my district, around 95% of people live within five miles of railroad
tracks. So if this happens again, and God forbid it does, we could all be
in danger. Not just here, but in so many communities like ours across the
country.

It's been a few years since this issue has been in the news, so you may be
wondering what has changed since the disaster in East Palestine.

The answer?

Nothing.

You know why?

Big, powerful corporate railroads throw their power around. They throw
their money around in Washington to block reforms, to block safety. Even
for communities to find out the results of bridge inspection reports
requires a member of Congress to go ask.

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/389?t=1003&akid=74%2E42639%2EOoRHg- ]I recorded a very short video on this topic. It won't take long to
watch, and I hope you will. Access it here.

[ https://act.chrisforpa.com/go/389?t=1004&akid=74%2E42639%2EOoRHg- ]Chris Deluzio on X: Big Railroads are trying to kill my Railway Safety
Act because our safety gets in the way of their lust for profirts. I'm
fighting back against corporate power, and -- despite the odds -- we're
winning the fight for rail safety.

Thank you for reading, watching, and hanging in there with me.

Don't give up the ship,

Chris Deluzio

Hey y'all
I always say that potholes don't have partisan labels. Nobody driving over one cares whether a Democrat or a Republican fills it. They just want it fixed.
Over the past two years as mayor, we paved 31.5 miles of streets in Columbia, the most miles in any two-year period in our city's history. We planned carefully, we worked together, and we got it done. All without property tax increases and while balancing the budget.
That's the same approach I'll take to Congress. Staying focused on the problems that actually affect people's lives, and working with anyone who's serious about solving them. Not partisan theater. Not scoring points online. Just results.
TN-05 deserves a congressman who shows up and gets things done, just as I have for eight years as Columbia's mayor.

Derek, this is an email from the Democratic National Committee about our work to take back control of Congress this November. Derek, it’s Mark Kelly. What do you say — you, me, and a friend meet up at the Air and Space Museum in Washington, DC?
If you chip in to the DNC through this email, you and a friend could win a free trip to our nation’s capital, where I’ll show you around my favorite museum on the mall.

I would be honored to meet you. Think about this: _99.7%_ of the DNC’s donations come from grassroots donors.
That means when you chip in, you’ll power efforts like the DNC’s largest-ever voter registration program in Arizona. You’ll take Trump to court. And, for a limited time, you’ll enter to get a personal tour of my favorite museum in DC.
This grassroots team is the front line of defense for our democracy and the engine of the Democratic movement.
I know I speak for so many Democrats when I say _thank you_.
